table_description: Shipping mode dimension table. Contains different shipping methods (e.g., REGULAR, EXPRESS, OVERNIGHT) used for catalog and web orders. Very small table (~20 rows). Referenced by CATALOG_SALES (CS_SHIP_MODE_SK), CATALOG_RETURNS (CR_SHIP_MODE_SK), and WEB_SALES (WS_SHIP_MODE_SK).
use_cases: Analyze shipping method preferences by channel
Compare delivery costs and timelines by ship mode
Order fulfillment analysis by shipping type
data_quality_notes: Very small dimension (~20 rows), safe to scan without filters
SM_SHIP_MODE_SK is the surrogate key used in fact table joins
SM_TYPE contains the shipping speed category (e.g., REGULAR, EXPRESS)
SM_CARRIER identifies the shipping carrier company

key_columns.name: SM_SHIP_MODE_SK
key_columns.description: Surrogate primary key. Join key for fact tables.

key_columns.name: SM_SHIP_MODE_ID
key_columns.description: Business/natural key for the shipping mode.

key_columns.name: SM_TYPE
key_columns.description: Shipping type/speed category (e.g., REGULAR, EXPRESS, OVERNIGHT, LIBRARY, TWO DAY).

key_columns.name: SM_CODE
key_columns.description: Shipping mode code (e.g., AIR, SURFACE, SEA).

key_columns.name: SM_CARRIER
key_columns.description: Shipping carrier name (e.g., FEDEX, UPS, DHL, USPS).

key_columns.name: SM_CONTRACT
key_columns.description: Contract identifier for the shipping arrangement.
